findings.description: The output contract says discover JSON carries counts and recency, and C5 says registered_path_missing and registered_unresolved rows without observed usage emit observed_count=0 and last_seen=null, but F004's pinned JSON row schema for those two states omits both fields.
findings.recommendation: Either add observed_count and last_seen to registered_path_missing and registered_unresolved JSON rows with 0/null defaults, or explicitly amend C5/objective wording so those states are exempt.

findings.description: Duplicate registry canonicalization is pinned for multiple entries sharing one canonical_repo_key, but the mixed active/inactive case is not deterministic. A lexicographically first inactive entry could suppress an active entry for the same canonical repo if dedupe happens before the active/stale truth table.
findings.recommendation: Pin duplicate handling across active flags, such as choosing the lexicographically first active entry when any active colliders exist, while inactive-only collisions remain inventory-only.

findings.description: C8 frames the sidecar lock as the coordination protocol for ledger writers, but F001 only pins lock acquisition for live appends while compact_ledger also rewrites invocations.jsonl. A concurrent compaction could still race an append or backfill rename unless it joins the same sidecar protocol or is explicitly proven out of scope.
findings.recommendation: Require compact_ledger and any ledger rewrite path to acquire the same sidecar lock before opening the data file, or pin a non-concurrency invariant with tests showing compaction cannot run during append/backfill.
